text:
incident-bot: ALERT: paging delivery failures detected for oncall-group 'infra-ops' (8m window). escalation suppressed by mapping mismatch. event_id=evt_72c2

maria: i was oncall and didn't get anything. i saw a slack mention only. :rotating_light:

kevin: seeing a spike of 401s from notify-connector -> pagerflow when it tries to POST to /webhook/translate. headers show X-Signature missing.

kevin: logs: ```
2026-03-18T05:10:12Z notify-connector ERROR deliverer.go:142 failed verify signature: missing header X-Hook-Signature
2026-03-18T05:10:13Z notify-connector WARN retrying 1/3 status=401 body="unauthorized"
```

elaine: we have a deploy bumped yesterday for signing-rotator. maybe the header name changed? cc @kevin

kevin: confirmed: rotator now returns `X-Hook-Sign` by default. mapping-service still expects `X-Hook-Signature`. mismatch introduced in 2026-03-17 22:08 deploy (rev d9f3).

robert: rollback? or quick compat patch to accept both headers in notify-connector.

kevin: rolling quick patch to accept fallback header `X-Hook-Sign`. patch -> `notify-connector` tag v1.12.3-hotfix. kicking now.

maria: meanwhile oncall folks are blind. elaine, can we manual page high-severity? customer-support has two customers reporting missed alert pings.
elaine: manual pages sent via Twilio for the affected oncall group at 05:18. posted summary to #oncall-ops.
jake: customers affected: cust-zenith (production), cust-lumen (staging). both reported "no pager received" between 05:10-05:20. support ticket IDs: S-2291, S-2292. i've notified account owners.
kevin: hotfix deployed (v1.12.3-hotfix) and smoke passed. notify-connector now accepts both headers and validates legacy tokens. delivery resumed at 05:24.
incident-bot: system note: pages delivered successfully after 05:24, backlog drained. total failed deliveries: 14.
maria: thanks. we should run a targeted rollout to the rotator team for a config revert or compatibility shim.
robert: i'll open a rollback PR for rotator to re-add `X-Hook-Signature` until we complete a formal deprecation plan. PR #4523.
elaine: ops checklist: (1) verify backlog cleared (2) confirm oncall receipts (3) update postmortem draft.
kevin: notes for postmortem: root cause = header name change introduced without cross-service contract update; contributing = missing integration test for signature header compatibility; impact = delayed paging for infra-ops, 2 customer tickets, 14 failed pages, manual Twilio pages sent. mitigation = hotfix, manual pages, rollback PR.
maria: timeline + owners in #incidents. please add any missing artifacts (logs, deploy IDs, timeline entries). i'll coordinate the postmortem and severity 2 classification.
jake: adding customer statements to the postmortem doc and including timestamps.
kevin: followup action: add an integration test in CI that simulates both header names, and a contract check between rotator and notify-connector. assigning to kevin/robert. ETA 48h.
incident-bot: ACTIONS CREATED: PM-188 (postmortem), ENG-889 (compat tests), OPS-774 (manual verification).
maria: good. closing live triage. keep thread for updates. :white_check_mark:
